root_motivation: WHO: the owner closing a team's account or moving hosts, and the member who wants their tools back. WHAT: one signed download of the whole team, one confirmed switch-off of every member key, one undo, and nothing deleted. WHY: export and offboard are per tenant and per key today, so a leaving team needs N humans to each run two tools and a mistaken offboard needs an operator.
user_persona: An org owner's agent that calls host.org.export, polls host.runs.get for the download_url, then calls host.org.offboard with the org name, and later host.org.restore if the owner changes their mind; and a member whose key answers tenant_disabled with org_offboard.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given an org of 3 members with 2 tools each, whose member keys the test rotated and discarded, When the owner runs host.org.export and the job completes, Then one signed download_url serves a tar.gz whose members/<ns>.tar.gz parts list each member's own tools as host.export does, org_manifest.members has 3 rows with matching sha256, and grep -c key_hash src/org_export.rs prints 0.

Given DISABLED_REASONS in src/auth_shape.rs, When the drift test scans src/ for disabled_reason writes and calls admin.tenants with each value and with bogus, Then no write spells a literal outside the const, each value filters its tenants, bogus is args_invalid, and SYNTHETIC_PURGE_REASONS still equals [idle_expired, self_offboard].
Given a member caller, When it calls host.org.export, host.org.offboard or host.org.restore, Then it gets not_owner and nothing is written.

Given the owner, When it calls host.org.offboard {confirm: wrong}, Then confirm_mismatch and every member stays enabled; with confirm equal to the org name, Then every live member, the owner included, is disabled = 1, disabled_reason = org_offboard, each member's next call answers tenant_disabled with that reason, and a repeat call answers already_offboarded.

Given an org offboarded at any age, When the synthetic and external expire and purge stages run and the owner then calls host.org.restore, Then no tenant, tool or state row was deleted, every member disabled by that offboard is enabled with a NULL reason and their tools answer, and one tenant_audit row org.restore exists per member.

Given a fixture org, When every tool in each member part's manifest.json is re-published into a fresh org with host.tool_publish and the fresh org is exported, Then the two org_manifest.json files agree on member count and, member by member, on tools[].name, kind and spec_sha256.

Given an org export already running, When the owner calls host.org.export again, Then the answer is, field for field, what host.export answers for its own duplicate on the same tree, and names the running run_id.

Given prod after this lands, When llms.txt is fetched, Then it documents host.org.export, host.org.offboard and host.org.restore (Live; evidence: curl -s https://mcphost.dev/llms.txt | grep -oE 'host\.org\.(export|offboard|restore)' | sort -u | wc -l prints 3)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred: Live (prod; evidence: curl -s https://mcphost.dev/llms.txt | grep -oE 'host\.org\.(export|offboard|restore)' | sort -u | wc -l prints 3)

scope: src/org_export.rs (host.org.export job, org_manifest.json); src/org_offboard.rs (host.org.offboard, host.org.restore, their Db methods); src/export.rs (build_tenant_archive, store_and_sign, ORG_EXPORT_TOOL_NAME in the download route); src/auth_shape.rs (DISABLED_REASONS, DISABLED_PASSES); src/org.rs (TOOLS, owned_org, org_live_members); migrations/0142_org_offboard.sql (orgs.offboarded_unix); descriptors, dispatch arms, write_verbs rows, output schemas and the generated contracts, docs, SDKs and llms.txt.
non_goals: Deleting any data or any prune or retention stage for offboarded orgs; importing an org bundle into another host; exporting secret values; re-creating a cancelled subscription; an approvals list in the bundle; changing the behaviour of host.export or host.self.offboard; the AC 8 prod read (operator-provisioned, deferred).

additional.no_version_bump: No version file is bumped; wm-build land bumps and tags.
additional.no_member_credentials: src/org_export.rs never reads a Tenant credential field; the member archive is built from the Tenant row by id and the owner's row signs the URL.
additional.one_reason_list: DISABLED_REASONS in src/auth_shape.rs is the only list of tenants.disabled_reason values; writers use its constants.
additional.nothing_deleted: org_offboard tenants are never purged and no stage deletes a tenant, tool or state row of an offboarded org.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can a team not leave in one step today?
five_whys_trace.a: host.export and host.self.offboard act on one tenant with its own key.
The archive builder and the disable flip were written for the tenant itself, not for an owner acting over members.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an owner-side job run the builder without a member key?
five_whys_trace.a: The builder takes a Tenant row and reads by tenant id; no key is part of what it reads.

five_whys_trace.q: Why a new disabled reason and a restore verb?
five_whys_trace.a: org_offboard must be distinguishable from self_offboard so it is restorable and never purged; deleting nothing keeps the undo free.
tenants.disabled_reason is plain TEXT, so writers, the admin filter and the purge list drift unless one const names them all.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Does a member keep host.export alone while org-offboarded?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: No: every member key is dark until host.org.restore; only the org verbs pass the disabled-tenant refusal, per (verb, reason).

ambiguities_resolved.question: Which members get an org.offboard or org.restore audit row?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Those the call changed: members already disabled for another reason are neither flipped nor restored and get no row.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Does restore reset last_seen_unix?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Yes, to the restore time, so no expiry sweep reads the offboarded interval as idleness.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What bounds the bundle size?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The owner's plan export_bytes_max, checked on the running sum of member parts and on the finished bundle (export_too_large).
